jobs.title: Senior Director, Enterprise Architecture - Corporate Technology Services
jobs.description:
Accelerate your success at Colliers.

Why Colliers?

As one of Canada’s leading commercial real estate services firms, we are driven by our mission to accelerate success for our people, clients, and communities.

A career at Colliers gives you the opportunity to make an impact, advance your career, and collaborate with top-tier talent. Don’t just take our word for it – we’ve been recognized as a top employer on a number of prestigious lists, including Best Workplaces in Canada, Best Workplaces with Most Trusted Executive Teams, among others.

Toronto, ON / Vancouver, BC, Hybrid

About The Role

As Global Domain Enterprise Architect, Corporate Technology Systems within our Global Enterprise Architecture organization, you’ll define the global architectural direction for the technology platforms supporting Colliers’ corporate functions. You’ll partner with business and technology leaders to simplify and modernize our global technology landscape, establish scalable standards, and ensure major technology investments translate into sustainable business outcomes. Support global time zones: Work closely with stakeholders across Pacific and APAC regions, with flexibility to adjust working hours on most days as business needs require.

Lead global enterprise architecture: Define current-state, target-state, and transition architectures, roadmaps, principles, and standards across ERP, Finance, HCM, Procurement, CRM/MarTech, Legal, Risk & Compliance, ECM, and other corporate platforms.
Drive modernization and simplification: Lead application portfolio rationalization and recommend where platforms should be standardized, modernized, consolidated, replaced, or retired to reduce technical debt and complexity.
Shape strategic technology investments: Provide architecture leadership for major transformation initiatives, evaluating SaaS and enterprise platforms against business value, integration, data, security, scalability, total cost, and long-term strategic fit.
Advance AI, data, and integration strategy: Establish scalable patterns for enterprise data, APIs, integration, automation, AI, identity, and shared services while embedding security, privacy, governance, and regulatory requirements.
Collaborate across the global enterprise: Partner with senior business leaders, Product, Data & AI, Cloud & DevOps, Cybersecurity, Integration, Legal, Procurement, Risk, and strategic vendors to turn architecture strategy into executable outcomes.

What You Bring

Education: Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Business, or a related discipline preferred.
12+ years of relevant experience: Significant experience in enterprise architecture, domain architecture, technology strategy, or large-scale transformation within complex global or federated organizations.
Enterprise platform architecture expertise: Demonstrated experience architecting and modernizing complex technology portfolios, including experience across at least two of the following three domains: Finance/ERP, HR/HCM, and CRM/MarTech.
Strong technical and transformation expertise: Deep understanding of SaaS platforms, application rationalization, enterprise integration, APIs, data architecture, cloud, cybersecurity, identity, AI/automation, and executable transition roadmaps.
Executive influence and communication: Proven ability to advise senior executives, challenge vendor and solution assumptions, and translate complex architectural decisions into clear business outcomes while remaining technically credible with architecture and engineering teams.

What We Offer

Innovative projects:
Work on cutting-edge initiatives that shape our communities, drive our growth, and make a tangible impact.

Career growth:
Advance your career and achieve your goals with industry-leading training and development programs.

Competitive benefits & compensation:
Enjoy a comprehensive and flexible benefits package along with competitive compensation that rewards your contributions and supports your well-being.

Collaborative culture:
Join our enterprising team where innovation thrives, collaboration is key, and our people are empowered to be their authentic selves and do their best work.

Diversity, Equity & Inclusion:
Our robust North American Diversity & Inclusion Program features eight Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), where you can connect, learn, and contribute to a diverse and supportive community. Learn more: https://www.collierscanada.com/en-ca/careers/diversity-and-inclusion

Global network
: Join a global team of 28,000 professionals across 70 countries, where you'll expand your network and learn from experts in a dynamic international community. Accelerate your career and enhance your expertise as you connect and collaborate with top talent around the world.

Applicants must be currently authorized to work in Canada on a full-time basis. The employer will not sponsor applicants for work visas.

Direct applicants only please, no agencies.

Colliers is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity in its workforce. Colliers encourages applications from all qualified individuals and will accommodate applicants' disability-related needs, up to the point of undue hardship, throughout all stages of the recruitment and selection process. If you require a disability-related accommodation to participate in the recruitment process, please contact the recruitment team by email at careers@colliers.com.

jobs.title: Vice-président adjoint, comptabilité et administration des fonds/ Private Markets, AVP
jobs.description:
ENGLISH FOLLOW**

Ce dont vous serez responsable

En tant que vice-président adjoint, comptabilité et administration des fonds, vous devrez :

gérer une équipe croissante de professionnels des services financiers lors de la production et de la prestation de services comptables et administratifs pour un ou plusieurs clients de placements non traditionnels
être principalement responsable de l’affectation des revenus aux investisseurs, de la détermination des frais de gestion et d’incitation conformément aux dispositions en cascade et du traitement des événements de capitaux tels que les appels de capitaux et les distributions
être responsable de la comptabilité du portefeuille et des fonds pour de nombreux fonds, y compris de l’examen et de l’approbation des rapports mensuels ou trimestriels sur la valeur liquidative
diriger l’intégration des fonds existants des clients et le lancement de nouveaux fonds
démontrer un engagement indéfectible envers la satisfaction du client
assurer le respect des politiques et procédures internes, et le respect des réglementations externes en vigueur
concevoir et promouvoir des solutions technologiques pour répondre aux exigences complexes des clients en matière de rapports et de données
cerner de façon proactive les occasions de vente croisée et y participer
participer à des groupes de travail stratégiques au sein de l’organisation pour améliorer les processus et notre modèle opérationnel
recruter, embaucher, former, motiver et perfectionner le personnel pour qu’il réalise son plein potentiel

Ce que nous valorisons

Ces compétences vous aideront à avoir du succès dans ce rôle.

Solides aptitudes pour la pensée critique, la résolution de problèmes et la prise de décisions
Bonnes aptitudes pour les relations interpersonnelles
Souci du détail
Gestion efficace du temps

Formation et compétences privilégiées

Baccalauréat en comptabilité ou en finances
Au moins 5 à 6 ans d’expérience en capital-investissement
Expérience souhaitée dans les catégories d’actif de placements non traditionnels, les structures de fonds complexes et le calcul des frais
Excellentes aptitudes pour la communication et la gestion
Capacité d’avoir du succès et de fonctionner dans un environnement soumis à des échéances serrées
La qualification CPA est un atout, mais non obligatoire
Expérience avec Investran ou Geneva préférable, mais non obligatoire
Une solide capacité écrite et orale en anglais est obligatoire pour couvrir tout client international.

À propos de State Street

Ce que nous faisons
. State Street est l’une des plus grandes banques dépositaires, gestionnaires d’actifs et sociétés de renseignements sur les actifs dans le monde. De la technologie à l’innovation de produits, nous faisons notre marque dans le secteur des services financiers. Depuis plus de deux siècles, nous aidons nos clients à protéger et à gérer les investissements de millions de personnes. Nous fournissons des services de placement, des données et des analyses, de la recherche et du commerce de placements et de la gestion des placements aux clients institutionnels.

Travailler. Vivre. Grandir.
Nous déployons tous les efforts pour créer un excellent environnement de travail. Nos avantages sociaux sont concurrentiels et complets. Les détails varient selon les endroits, mais vous pouvez vous attendre à de généreux soins.

Inclusion, Diversité. Responsabilité sociale.
Nous croyons vraiment que la diversité des antécédents, des expériences et des points de vue de nos employés contribue grandement à créer un environnement inclusif où chacun peut s’épanouir et réaliser son plein potentiel tout en ajoutant de la valeur à notre organisation et à nos clients. Nous accueillons chaleureusement les candidats de diverses origines, origines, capacités, âge, orientation sexuelle, identité de genre et personnalité. Une autre valeur fondamentale de State Street est l’engagement actif avec nos communautés partout dans le monde, en tant que partenaire et leader. Vous aurez des outils pour aider à équilibrer votre vie professionnelle et personnelle, des journées de bénévolat rémunérées, un programme de dons de contrepartie et l’accès aux réseaux d’employés qui vous aident à rester connecté à ce qui vous importe.

State Street est un employeur d’égalité des chances et d’action positive.

Découvrez toutes les opportunités disponibles chez State Street à Statestreet.com/careers.

Who We Are Looking For

State Street is an industry leader in providing administrative fund services to both Hedge Fund and Private Equity managers within our Alternative Investment Solutions business group. Our PE team delivers customized service solutions for investment funds that have closed end structures and a variety of portfolio investments. This opportunity uniquely offers candidates the opportunity to service hybrid hedge and private equity products for industry leading asset managers. The PE NAV role is the hub in the delivery of administrative services. Employees interact daily with functional teams including trade operations, investor services, custody, tax, and financial reporting locally and in globally diverse locations.

Why this role is important to us

The team you will be joining is a part of State Street Global Services (SSGS). SSGS gives asset owners and managers access to the essential financial tools they need to deliver effective investment solutions. From core custody, accounting, fund administration and shareholder recordkeeping, to complete operations solutions and servicing for alternative assets like OTC derivatives, private equity and real estate, SSGS’ tools help our clients make better investment choices and act on growth opportunities.

Join us if making your mark in the financial services industry from day one is a challenge you are up for.

What You Will Be Responsible For

As Fund Accounting & Administration, AVP you will:

Manage a growing team of financial services professionals in the production and delivery of accounting and administrative services for one or more alternative investment client relationships.
Primarily responsible for the allocation of income to investors, determination of management and incentive fees in accordance with the waterfall provisions, and processing capital events such as capital calls and distributions.
Responsible for the portfolio and fund level accounting for numerous funds including the review and approval of monthly or quarterly net asset value reporting.
Lead the onboarding of existing client funds and the launch of new funds.
Demonstrate an unrelenting commitment to client satisfaction.
Ensure adherence with internal policies and procedures and compliance with external governing regulations.
Design and champion technology solutions to address the complex reporting and data requirements of clients.
Proactively identify and participate in cross-sell opportunities.
Participate in strategic working groups within the organization to improve processes and our operating model.
Recruit, hire, train, motivate, and develop staff to realize their full

What We Value

These skills will help you succeed in this role.

Strong critical thinking, problem solving, and decision-making skills.
Good interpersonal skills
Attention to detail.
Effective time management

Education & Preferred Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in accounting or finance
At least 5 to 6 years of Private Equity experience
Experience with alternative investment asset classes, complex fund structures and fee calculations desired.
Highly effective communication and management skills
Ability to thrive and function in a high-pressure deadline driven environment.
CPA qualification is favorable but not required.
Experience with Investran or Geneva favorable but not required.
Strong English written and spoken ability is mandatory to cover international client.

About State Street

What we do.
State Street is one of the largest custodian banks, asset managers and asset intelligence companies in the world. From technology to product innovation we’re making our mark on the financial services industry. For more than two centuries, we’ve been helping our clients safeguard and steward the investments of millions of people. We provide investment servicing, data & analytics, investment research & trading and investment management to institutional clients.

Work, Live and Grow.
We make all efforts to create a great work environment. Our benefits packages are competitive and comprehensive. Details vary in locations, but you may expect generous medical care, insurance and savings plans among other perks. You’ll have access to flexible Work Program to help you match your needs. And our wealth of development programs and educational support will help you reach your full potential.

Inclusion, Diversity and Social Responsibility.
We truly believe our employees’ diverse backgrounds, experiences and perspective are a powerful contributor to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive and reach their maximum potential while adding value to both our organization and our clients. We warmly welcome the candidates of diverse origin, background, ability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity and personality. Another fundamental value at State Street is active engagement with our communities around the world, both as a partner and a leader. You will have tools to help balance your professional and personal life, paid volunteer days, matching gift program and access to employee networks that help you stay connected to what matters to you.

State Street is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer.

Discover more at StateStreet.com/careers

Salary Range:

$91,000 - $140,500 Annual

The range quoted above applies to the role in the primary location specified. If the candidate would ultimately work outside of the primary location above, the applicable range could differ.

About State Street

Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.

We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. As an essential partner in our shared success, you’ll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most. Join us in shaping the future.

As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we consider all qualified applicants for all positions without regard to race, creed, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, ethnicity, age, disability, genetic information, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, citizenship, marital status, domestic partnership or civil union status, familial status, military and veteran status, and other characteristics protected by applicable law.

Discover more information on jobs at StateStreet.com/careers

Read our CEO Statement

jobs.title: Head of Tax
jobs.description:
Head of Tax

Writeoff Inc.
· Fully remote (Canada) · Full-time

About Writeoff

Writeoff is a fully remote, AI-native tax and accounting firm. We work with owner-managed corporations across Canada and the US, handling their bookkeeping and tax on flat monthly fees. Our stack (QuickBooks Online, TaxCycle, Claude, Aqqrue, Notion, Granola) takes care of the grunt work that buries most firms: data entry, reconciliations, chasing documents. That leaves our people doing the work that actually needs a professional: judgment, planning and owning the client relationship.
This is our first Head of Tax. Not a rung on a ladder: the seat at the table. We want someone technically strong, with SMB experience, who's tired of building somebody else's practice.

The Role

This is a player-coach role. You'll fully own Writeoff's client tax relationships and everything that comes with them: compliance, planning, CRA, and being the person founders call when it actually matters. You'll review and sign off on the work, plan the complex files yourself, and lead a small team of preparers. And because we're AI-native, you'll be expected to get creative with AI and ship useful solutions to important problems, for our clients and for how tax gets done here. You report directly to the founder, and what you build here is yours.

What You'll Do

Own tax quality

Prepare, review and file T2, T1 and T3 returns, T4/T5/T4A slips and summaries, GST/HST returns and payroll filings, all in TaxCycle
Set the review standards, checklists and workpaper conventions the team works from
Be the final word on technical positions and how we document them

Plan for owner-managers

Advise on remuneration (salary vs. dividends), SBD and association, GRIP, CDA and safe income
Lead reorganizations and planning: s.85 rollovers, holdco structures, estate freezes, pipelines, LCGE / QSBC purification
Family trust planning: setting up and running trusts in freezes, TOSI, the 21-year deemed disposition
Support SR&ED claims and other credits
Work through deal and transaction tax on asset and share sales

Lead the team

Manage and develop 1 to 2 tax preparers, reviewing their work and teaching as you go
Help us hire as the tax practice grows

Build the machine

Help design our AI-native tax workflow end to end: client intake, QBO to GIFI mapping, TaxCycle prep, review and e-filing
Turn your judgment into repeatable checklists, prompts and processes the team and our AI tools can run on

Work with clients

Own the tax relationship for your clients end to end: you're their go-to for anything tax, mostly over Slack
Handle CRA correspondence, reviews and audits
Coordinate with our US partner firms on cross-border files

What you Bring

CPA designation (required)
5+ years of Canadian tax experience with SMB and owner-managed clients, ideally in public practice
Hands-on TaxCycle experience (T1 and T2)
Real volume on T2 prep and filing: GIFI, schedules, SBD and association, year-end adjustments
T-slip prep and filing: T4, T5, T4A and summaries, plus T5018 where it applies
Trust experience: T3 returns, the expanded trust reporting rules (Schedule 15), and trusts used in freezes and family planning
Foreign reporting and non-residents: T1134, T1135, T106, NR4 and s.116
Reorg and transaction work you can scope, price and deliver: s.85 and s.86 rollovers, amalgamations, wind-ups, estate freezes, purification
Strong command of corporate and personal tax for CCPCs and their shareholders
Experience reviewing other people's work and explaining the "why" behind your comments
Comfort talking to business owners in plain language
Genuine curiosity about AI and new tools, and a willingness to change how things are done when there's a better way
Ability to juggle many clients at once in a remote, async environment

Nice to Have

CPA In-Depth Tax Course completed or in progress
Cross-border exposure: US C-corps, Delaware structures, QSBS, treaty issues, non-resident filings
SR&ED experience
QuickBooks Online experience

Compensation

Base salary: $120,000 - $150,000 CAD
, depending on experience
Benefits package included
4 weeks of vacation
Real ownership, on a real timeline.
At a traditional firm you grind ten-plus years for a shot at partner, write a cheque to buy in, and end up with a sliver and a vote. Here the path is measured in years, not decades, and the stake is meaningful. You're not renting a seat. You own part of what you build, and every client you win and every system you ship grows your piece of it.
Fully remote, anywhere in Canada, plus one in-person company offsite a year
